comment: Reviewed exemptions for the i18n gate (Stop-chain step). Every user-facing string in apps/mobile/src, apps/mobile/app, apps/web/lib and apps/web/app must be a key in that surface's i18n catalog, and locale-sensitive formatting (Intl, toLocale*, toFixed) must live only in that surface's i18n/ directory. A string the gate flags that is genuinely never read by a human, or a formatting call that genuinely must bypass the locale, goes here as {"key": "<12 hex characters>", "reason": "..."}: the gate's FAIL line prints the entry ready to paste. The key hashes the file's path, the finding kind, the attribute or property name and the text, so it stays on the string when lines move; a key that matches no finding FAILS as stale. The 1.0.x {"site": "file:line"} form was retired at 2.0.0: it FAILS as malformed on every install, and the FAIL line of the string it muted prints the key that replaces it. Write-guard-protected + gate-integrity-hashed: widening it is a reviewed human act. Empty by design — the shipped app routes every string through the catalog.
